name: Morathi
canonNotes: Hag Sorceress, mother of Malekith and high priestess of Slaanesh in secret, the most beautiful and dangerous of the Druchii.
Keeps her youth through the Cauldrons of Blood; a master of seduction and manipulation.
voiceNotes: Seductive, mocking and manipulative; every word is a lure.
Rivalry with Hellebron, uneasy loyalty to her son.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
